pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   D. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   C. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   D. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. B — Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. B — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
